english_classification.chapter_title: Also concerning the Catechumen; shall he be saved in a single Body?
english_classification.chapter_note: This chapter contains no identifiable cosmological-correspondential substrate. It is entirely composed of institutional material about catechumenate practices (fasting rules, alms, prayer schedules, sin-accounting, forgiveness conditions), wrapped in dialogue frame and closed with exhortation. Teaching purity is 0.055 — near zero. Cosmological vocabulary appears sporadically ('light from darkness,' 'Light Mind,' 'light image,' 'land of rest') but always in service of institutional soteriology, never as systematic cosmos-to-cosmos mapping. The NT citation of 1 Cor. 7 in ¶4 is explicitly flagged as a Gospel-derived teaching. The chapter is a pure product of the Manichaean institutional layer — prescriptive rules for the catechumenate with eschatological incentives.
